description: Step 1 of 2. Returns an EIP-4361 (Sign-In with Ethereum) message for a wallet address this agent controls, valid five minutes, single use. Signing it accepts the AmpleRun Terms version it names. Sign the message exactly as returned with personal_sign (EIP-191), then call register_agent_account with message and signature. Never send a private key to any tool.

address.description: The agent's wallet address (0x...). Defaults to this server's wallet when it has one.

title: Start registering this agent's own AmpleRun account
